sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
